title: Claude for Google Workspace
hook_before: Claude just arrived directly inside Google Docs, Sheets, and Slides.
script:
Claude just landed in Google Docs.
Anthropic built this integration to bring advanced writing and data analysis straight to your browser tabs.
You can draft reports, analyze spreadsheets, and build presentations without switching apps.
It handles complex editing tasks in seconds while you work on your documents.
Would you switch from Gemini to use this?
